meta.subject: 英文
meta.title: Unit 1 How Do You Go to School?

questions.question: A: How do you go to school? B: I go to school ______ bus.
questions.explanation: 搭乘交通工具用 by + 交通工具。

questions.question: She goes to the park ______ foot.
He goes to school by ______ (腳踏車).
Plane is a kind of transportation.
questions.explanation: 飛機 (plane) 是一種交通工具。

questions.question: How ______ he go to the zoo?
questions.explanation: he 是第三人稱單數，用 does。
